narrative.overview:
The cloth is the loudest thing on every page. Ankara, kente, adire and embroidered cloth bring the pattern and the saturated colour; the interface around them is raw cotton, sand and charcoal ink, and stays out of the way. The look is a high-end tailor's shop: a quiet room, good light, the garments hung where you can see them.

The type holds that balance. Bodoni Moda, a high-contrast serif with a true italic, sets headlines with editorial confidence. Hanken Grotesk does the work: names, prices, delivery facts, labels. Corners are square, surfaces are flat, and lines are hairline seams. A single cool accent, Adire Indigo, named after the Yoruba indigo-dyed cloth, marks interaction and one band of the home page. Motion is slow and soft, like cloth settling, and switches off for anyone who asks for less motion.

The density is generous on editorial surfaces (hero, cloth band, story) and tight and orderly where people shop (grids, filters, product form).
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, warm ground; photography and cloth supply all pattern and strong colour.
Bodoni Moda display over Hanken Grotesk working text.
Square corners, hairline borders, flat surfaces.
One accent, Adire Indigo, used sparingly.
One easing, three speeds; all motion off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Cloth Carries Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour and pattern come from the photographs and the cloth. Interface chrome (buttons, panels, badges, borders) stays in the cotton, sand and ink neutrals. Never print a pattern or a bright fill into the UI itself.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Adire Indigo is the only accent. It marks interaction (hover, focus) and appears as a ground once per page at most. Don't add a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A campaign headline may set one word or phrase in Bodoni italic (the campaign's italic_word). One per headline, never a whole line.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Works Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda is for headings and the search field only. Prices, sizes, delivery dates, buttons and labels are always Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Flat Floor Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels and buttons have no shadow at rest or on hover. A shadow means "this floats above the page" and nothing else.

dos: Do let photography and cloth bring the colour; keep chrome in Raw Cotton, Sand Stone and Charcoal Ink.
Do set headings in Bodoni Moda and every price, size, date and label in Hanken Grotesk.
Do keep every corner square except colour swatches.
Do use Adire Indigo only for hover, focus and at most one ground per page.
Do use the shop's one easing and three durations for any new motion, and make sure it switches off under reduced motion.
Do keep product photos 3:4 on Sand Stone.
donts: Don't print African patterns, kente stripes or bright fills into buttons, borders, backgrounds or badges; the cloth in the photos already does this.
Don't add rounded corners, pill buttons or card shadows.
Don't introduce a second accent colour.
Don't set body text, prices or buttons in the serif.
Don't animate text on scroll; only photos ease in.
Don't put a small label or eyebrow above a heading; the heading carries itself (a campaign's own label is the exception).
